\documentclass[english,12pt,a4paper,oneside]{article}

% University formatting: A4, one-sided, 12 pt Times-like body, 1.5 spacing,
% justified paragraphs, and approximately 3 cm margins.
\usepackage[a4paper,margin=30mm]{geometry}
\usepackage{fontspec}
\setmainfont{texgyretermes-regular.otf}[
  BoldFont=texgyretermes-bold.otf,
  ItalicFont=texgyretermes-italic.otf,
  BoldItalicFont=texgyretermes-bolditalic.otf
]
\setsansfont{texgyreheros-regular.otf}[
  BoldFont=texgyreheros-bold.otf,
  ItalicFont=texgyreheros-italic.otf,
  BoldItalicFont=texgyreheros-bolditalic.otf
]
\setmonofont{lmmono10-regular.otf}[
  ItalicFont=lmmono10-italic.otf
]
\usepackage[english]{babel}
\usepackage{microtype}
\usepackage{setspace}
\setstretch{1.5}
\usepackage[bottom]{footmisc}

\usepackage{amsmath,amssymb}
\usepackage{graphicx}
\usepackage{booktabs}
\usepackage{longtable}
\usepackage{array}
\usepackage{tabularx}
\usepackage{calc}
\usepackage{xcolor}
\usepackage{caption}
\usepackage{float}
\usepackage{enumitem}
\usepackage{needspace}
\usepackage{etoolbox}
\usepackage{xurl}
\usepackage{hyperref}

\input{config.tex}

% No orphan or widow lines, and no headings stranded at the page bottom.
\clubpenalty=10000
\widowpenalty=10000
\displaywidowpenalty=10000
\brokenpenalty=10000
\raggedbottom
\pretocmd{\section}{\needspace{5\baselineskip}}{}{}
\pretocmd{\subsection}{\needspace{4\baselineskip}}{}{}

% Keep code and wide tables within the text block.
\AtBeginEnvironment{verbatim}{\footnotesize}
\makeatletter
\define@key{Gin}{alt}{}
\makeatother
\setkeys{Gin}{width=0.88\linewidth,height=0.46\textheight,keepaspectratio}
\providecommand{\pandocbounded}[1]{#1}
\providecommand{\tightlist}{%
  \setlength{\itemsep}{0pt}\setlength{\parskip}{0pt}}

\renewcommand{\topfraction}{0.90}
\renewcommand{\bottomfraction}{0.80}
\renewcommand{\textfraction}{0.08}
\renewcommand{\floatpagefraction}{0.80}

\hypersetup{
  hidelinks,
  pdftitle={$title$},
  pdfauthor={$for(author)$$author$$sep$; $endfor$}
}
\urlstyle{same}

% The supplied university template uses paragraph spacing; keeping zero indent
% also guarantees that the first paragraph after a heading is not indented.
\setlength{\parindent}{0pt}
\setlength{\parskip}{0.72em}
\setlength{\emergencystretch}{3em}
\setcounter{secnumdepth}{2}
\setcounter{tocdepth}{2}
\pagestyle{plain}

% APA 7 reference-list layout: unnumbered entries with a 0.5-inch hanging indent.
\newcommand{\APAReferenceSetup}{%
  \setlength{\leftskip}{0.5in}%
  \setlength{\parindent}{-0.5in}%
  \setlength{\parskip}{0pt}%
  \Urlmuskip=0mu plus 1mu\relax
}

\captionsetup{
  font=small,
  labelfont=bf,
  width=0.88\linewidth
}
\newcounter{none}

\renewcommand{\arraystretch}{1.08}
\setlength{\tabcolsep}{3.2pt}
\let\oldlongtable\longtable
\let\endoldlongtable\endlongtable
\renewenvironment{longtable}{\footnotesize\setlength{\tabcolsep}{2.4pt}\oldlongtable}{\endoldlongtable\normalsize}

% The formal requirements assign Roman page numbers to the appendix.
\let\standardappendix\appendix
\renewcommand{\appendix}{%
  \clearpage
  \pagenumbering{Roman}%
  \setcounter{page}{1}%
  \standardappendix
}

\begin{document}

\pagenumbering{gobble}
\input{cldh/frontpage}

$if(abstract)$
\section*{Abstract}
$abstract$
$if(keywords)$

\vspace{0.6em}\noindent\textbf{Keywords:}~$for(keywords)$$keywords$$sep$, $endfor$
$endif$
$endif$

$if(toc)$
\clearpage
\tableofcontents
$endif$

% The title page and front matter are unnumbered; Introduction starts at page 1.
\clearpage
\pagenumbering{arabic}
\setcounter{page}{1}

$body$

\input{cldh/originality-confirm}

\end{document}
